parts.note: twice means double, two times over
going Dutch is paying your own share of a bill

explanation.surface: Someone who pays their own way twice over finds the arrangement baffling.
explanation.walkthrough: The pieces come in reverse order from the clue: 'twice' supplies the first word and 'Paying for yourself' the second.
explanation.definitionFit: Double Dutch is the idiom for speech or writing that makes no sense to the listener, gibberish.

indicators.note: becomes signals the name Lois turning into something else, its letters rearranged

explanation.surface: A woman called Lois turns into a spiritualist who talks to the dead.
explanation.definitionFit: Oil paints are a medium in art, the material an artist works in.

clue.text: He may put up his house for sale

definitions.text: He may put up his house for sale

parts.words: He may put up his house for sale
parts.note: reads like a homeowner advertising a sale, but 'put up' means construct: a tradesman who erects houses to sell

explanation.surface: A homeowner lists his property on the market.
explanation.definitionFit: A tradesman in construction erects houses, often speculatively for sale.

clue.text: The way to travel to gain time

definitions.text: The way to travel to gain time

parts.words: The way to travel to gain time
parts.note: way here is a compass direction: heading towards the sunrise means clocks go forward across time zones

explanation.surface: Advice on the best route for someone in a hurry.
explanation.walkthrough: Flying towards the sunrise puts you into later time zones, so the clock jumps ahead.
explanation.definitionFit: A compass direction is a way; journeying sunward crosses zones where local time is ahead.

clue.text: American friend seen around the youth centre generally

indicators.note: seen around tells us the two words for American and friend sit either side of a letter

parts.note: US is the abbreviation for American, as in US citizen
an ally is a friend or supporter

indicators.note: centre picks the middle letter of the five-letter word youth

explanation.surface: An American pal is spotted hanging around the local youth club, as he typically is.
explanation.walkthrough: 'youth centre' reads as a youth club, but 'centre' picks the middle letter of 'youth'; 'seen around' tells you the American friend wraps round it.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words mean as a rule, in most cases.

clue.text: Written authority for many to strike

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred, a crossword stand-in for many
to hit is to strike

explanation.surface: A document authorising a large workforce to walk out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Strike' suggests industrial action, but it just means hit.
explanation.definitionFit: A chit is a short note or voucher authorising something, such as a payment.

clue.text: Changing one's mind looks bad during the holidays

indicators.note: during places the word for bad within the word for holidays

parts.note: vacation is the American and university word for holidays
ill means bad, as in ill effects

explanation.surface: Dithering over plans looks poor form while everyone is on holiday.
explanation.definitionFit: Vacillation is wavering between opinions, never settling on one decision.

parts.note: each word is denied: hardly pretty means unattractive and hardly smart means dim, the two forming a phrase meaning utterly foolish

explanation.surface: A sceptical reply to someone praised as rather clever.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pretty' reads as 'rather', but it is the adjective: the opposite of pretty is plain, the opposite of smart is stupid.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means completely foolish; taken word by word it is also unattractive and dim.

clue.text: In this one can be patient in solitude

definitions.text: In this one can be patient in solitude

parts.words: In this one can be patient in solitude
parts.note: patient is the noun, a hospital inpatient, given a room alone rather than the virtue of waiting calmly

explanation.surface: Advice that a quiet retreat helps one cultivate patience.
explanation.definitionFit: A hospital room for one fee-paying person lets a sick person stay alone.

parts.note: Dis is the Roman god of the underworld and also the underworld itself
a solution is the answer to a problem

explanation.surface: The realm of the dead offers a way out of marriage.
explanation.definitionFit: Dissolution of a marriage is the legal ending of it, a formal break-up.

indicators.note: perhaps hints the letters of clue to Diana might be arranged another way

explanation.surface: A helpful hint passed to a woman called Diana.
explanation.definitionFit: Educational material teaches, giving useful knowledge.

definitions.meaning: side is affected superiority, as in putting on side, giving oneself pretensions
breezes or light winds, an old poetic sense

explanation.definitionFit: Putting on airs is like putting on side, both showing conceit; airs are also gentle breezes.

definitions.meaning: bound means fastened or tethered with rope
teams who finish level have drawn the match

explanation.definitionFit: Something knotted fast is bound; a drawn match leaves both sides level, having drawn.

indicators.note: out signals the letters of the preceding words being thrown out of order

explanation.surface: A trespasser is chased off the premises.
explanation.walkthrough: 'driven out' reads as the trespasser's fate, but 'driven' is fodder with 'a' and 'out' alone is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: An invader forces their way into territory not their own, an unwelcome trespasser.

clue.text: Come up to stretch between bends

definitions.meaning: to arrive at or attain a place or level
a straight length of river between two curves

explanation.definitionFit: To arrive at somewhere is to get there; a river's straight section between turns has the same name.

definitions.meaning: a great work of literature with lasting standing
the five major English flat horse races, such as the Derby, are called by this name

explanation.definitionFit: A great enduring novel is so called, as are the five big English flat races like the Derby.

clue.text: Demand by miners after a strike?

definitions.meaning: to demand something is to insist it is owed
prospectors who strike gold stake ownership of the plot, not an industrial dispute

explanation.definitionFit: Insisting on a right is making a demand; prospectors who find gold stake out a plot as theirs.

parts.note: the old reprimand to children, read literally as answering someone who addresses you

explanation.surface: A parent tells a child to stay quiet unless addressed.
explanation.definitionFit: To respond is to speak back after someone addresses you.

parts.note: L is the Roman numeral fifty, standing for many
someone who ate took food rather than drink

explanation.surface: Lots of people stayed sober once the pubs closed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'after time' is the pub's closing time; the definition means overdue.
explanation.definitionFit: Late means coming after the expected hour, overdue.

definitions.meaning: dull and lifeless, as in a dreary performance
a painted wooden frame used as backdrop on a theatre stage

explanation.definitionFit: A dull performance is lifeless; in theatre a painted framed backdrop panel shares the name.

definitions.meaning: an old word for a pilgrim's or shepherd's small satchel
certificates issued for a holding of stock, such as a bonus issue

explanation.definitionFit: A pilgrim's satchel had this name; it is also a certificate for stock held.

indicators.note: in places the rearranged letters within the word for total

parts.note: a sum is a total

indicators.note: up signals the word tart being stirred up, its letters rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone dolls up a cake layer in its entirety.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tart up' reads as a phrasal verb meaning smarten, but 'up' is the anagram signal on 'tart', and 'in' sets the result inside the total.
explanation.definitionFit: A stratum is one level of rock or society, a layer among others.

clue.text: Artist keeps a boat by the bank

definitions.meaning: someone who makes pictures

definitions.text: keeps a boat by the bank
definitions.meaning: a rope at a small boat's bow used to tie it up

explanation.definitionFit: A picture-maker carries the name, as does the bow rope tying a dinghy to the shore.

clue.text: Bank has a way to avoid a row

definitions.meaning: a riverside or canal bank path

definitions.text: a way to avoid a row
definitions.meaning: a path for horses to haul boats, so no one need take the oars

explanation.definitionFit: A canal-side track where horses hauled barges: hauling means no rowing, and the bank holds it.

parts.note: a distinguished conductor or composer, given the Italian title of master

explanation.surface: A teacher of music at a school.
explanation.definitionFit: An eminent conductor or composer is given this Italian honorific.

clue.text: Taking the middle course is for us

indicators.note: taking the middle means keeping the inner letters of course, dropping its first and last

explanation.surface: Choosing moderation suits people like us.
explanation.definitionFit: The possessive pronoun means belonging to us, reserved for us.

definitions.meaning: to convert goods into cash, as in realising assets
a hoax or swindle

explanation.definitionFit: Converting assets into money means selling them; a sell is also a hoax.

clue.text: Recognise a refusal when you hear it

indicators.note: hearing the word means it is spoken, so the sound counts rather than the spelling

parts.note: no is the word of refusal

explanation.surface: You can spot a turndown as soon as it is spoken.
explanation.definitionFit: To know someone or something can mean to identify them, recognise them.

parts.note: cod is a fish

explanation.surface: A fish has a tail fin.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tail-piece' suggests a fish's tail, but it is the musical term.
explanation.definitionFit: A coda is the closing passage of a piece of music.

parts.note: nut is slang for the head, so this cracker breaks heads rather than shells

explanation.surface: A kitchen gadget for opening nuts.
explanation.definitionFit: A cosh is a short heavy club for hitting people on the head.

clue.text: Distant one I set out for

definitions.text: Distant one I set out for

indicators.note: set out suggests the letters of distant one I being laid out afresh

explanation.surface: A far-off place is the goal of my journey.
explanation.definitionFit: A journey's end is the place one heads towards.

clue.text: By law mother might be culpable

indicators.note: might be hints that the letters of by law mother could form something else

explanation.surface: A legal ruling says a mother may be at fault.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words mean deserving blame for a fault.
